name: The Fig Tree
accommodation: Around 20 to 25 rooms from bijou doubles to suites, some with sea views
suitableFor: Couples wanting a relaxed boutique stay near the beach
dogs: Pets welcome for a charge (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
beachAccess: Minutes from Shanklin beach; about 0.19 miles (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
confirmedFeatures: Terrace restaurant and bar, breakfast included, lift, accessible rooms, Wi-Fi
overview: The Fig Tree is a boutique hotel on Queen's Road in Shanklin, a few minutes' walk from the beach and the Old Village. Its rooms are bright and spacious, some with sea views, and breakfast from local produce is included. There is a terrace restaurant and bar and free parking on site.
surfTripFit: Free parking and a short walk to the beach, with breakfast included for early starts.
